events.title: Linux Support
events.summary: Cubic Color Confusion now natively supports Linux!The following changes are included in this update:GeneralNative Linux SupportCross-Platform progress between Windows & LinuxMulti-Display support should now work for both Windows & LinuxFixed replay recorder not using normalized grid axes which could render replays invalidTooltips for the ingame-HUD buttons now show current bindingsControlsAnalog Sticks now use the predominant axis only instead of sending multiple inputsAdded missing Gamepad butt

events.summary: Based on user feedback, i made some small improvements across the board.Here's an overview of what changed:Broken TilesVisibility of Broken Tiles has been improved by using a darker tint for the tiles and rotating them based on their position in the grid. Broken tiles should be easier to identify now.Music PlayerThe music player player has a new icon next to the currently playing track so it identifies as a music player. events.title: Only one week until the demo will be available!
events.summary: On August 17th, in just one week, the public demo of Cubic Color Confusion will be available to everyone!I'm so excited to finally be able to share what I've been working on for so long with all of you.See you on launch day — and get those brain cells ready!
